name: Files attached to a task: .task-files store, journal authority, streamed upload, safe download
aliases: attach a file to a task
summary: A coordinator attaches files to a task for its assignee (to-worker) and the assignee attaches results (from-worker): GET/PUT /v1/projects/{id}/tasks/{task}/files, GET .../files/{sha256}, POST .../files/{sha256}/withdraw. Bytes live in projects/NAME/.task-files/<2 hex>/<sha256> (content-addressed; a symlinked folder is refused). A file is attached only by its host journal entry under .task-files/records, written by the service-only endpoint action task-file under the project lock and live authority; the reserved Kind: task-file-v1 / task-file-withdrawn-v1 comments are the history record, so a planted one is inert. Who may is read live: coordinators (CAP_COORDINATE) and the current assignee of an open task download; every reader lists. The upload is the one streamed route (Content-Length required, limits and free disk checked first, 64 KiB steps, digest checked, connection closed after). Limits are deployment.private.json task_files settings; at most 4 transfers in the service and 2 per caller (503 Retry-After); every upload, download and withdrawal is audited.
